name: GitHub-Release-Monitor
description: Get told when your favourite GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg and Forgejo projects ship a release

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Your watched repositories, settings and sign-in database (auth.db), plus .better_auth_secret and .auth_setup_token, this install's own keys made on first start. Back this folder up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: GitHub Release Monitor web app, published on host as 6182

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: BETTER_AUTH_URL
variables.description: The address you open the app at. Sign-in already works from http://YOUR-SERVER-IP:6182 on your home network with localhost here. Change it for working links in emails, like http://192.168.1.20:6182, or to your https address behind a reverse proxy.

variables.name: GITHUB_ACCESS_TOKEN
variables.description: Recommended. A GitHub personal access token with no scopes. It raises GitHub's limit from 60 to 5000 checks an hour.
